meta.description: Lightweight WSI tile extraction and preprocessing. Use for basic slide processing, tissue detection, tile extraction, and stain normalization for H&E images. Best for simple pipelines, dataset preparation, and quick tile-based analysis. For advanced spatial proteomics use pathml.

scientific_integrity.detail: No data fabrication; processes real whole slide images with proper tissue detection and tile extraction methodology

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for basic WSI processing; clearly distinguishes from pathml for advanced spatial proteomics and multiplexed imaging

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established digital pathology practices with proper tissue detection, tile extraction, and stain normalization methods

code_usability.detail: Complete working examples for all major workflows with proper parameter guidance and quality control recommendations

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of 6 capability areas (slide management, tissue detection, tile extraction, filters, stain normalization, visualization); excellent 5-reference progressive disclosure

reliability.note: Good version specification (0.7.0) with Python compatibility (3.8-3.11); OpenSlide dependency documented; minor: no explicit guidance on handling extraction failures

performance_context.note: Well-organized 244-line SKILL.md with excellent progressive disclosure through 5 detailed reference files; clear workflow structure

agent_usability.note: Perfect trigger description with specific WSI operations and use-case patterns; clear when-to-use guidance; explicit alternative (pathml for advanced workflows)

human_usability.note: Excellent setup instructions with OpenSlide system library requirement, Python version constraints, and platform compatibility (Linux/macOS, not Windows)

security.note: Good handling of WSI files with proper path management; sample data via pooch noted; minor: no explicit guidance on handling potentially malicious slide files

maintainability.note: Good structure with version 1.2, license (Apache-2.0), compatibility notes; minor: no changelog reference

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with clear input/output contracts; excellent progressive disclosure with 5 reference files; good quality control guidance; minor: batch processing workflows could be more explicit

key_strengths: Comprehensive coverage of 6 WSI processing capability areas with excellent progressive disclosure through 5 detailed reference files (slide management, tissue masks, tile extraction, filters, visualization)
Perfect agent discoverability with clear use-case patterns and explicit scope boundary (use pathml for advanced spatial proteomics)
Strong quality control guidance with mandatory locate_tiles() preview, tissue_percent thresholds, and score distribution review
Excellent troubleshooting section covering all common failure modes with specific fixes for no tiles, background tiles, slow extraction, and artifacts
Clear platform compatibility documentation (Python 3.8-3.11, Linux/macOS, not Windows) with OpenSlide system dependency

recommendations.title: Add target image selection guidance for stain normalization

recommendations.fix: Add to filters_preprocessing.md or best practices: criteria for selecting stain normalization target (e.g., median-quality slide, representative staining, avoid artifacts)

recommendations.title: Add explicit guidance on handling extraction failures
recommendations.problem: No explicit error handling pattern for failed tile extractions
recommendations.root_cause: Reliability section focuses on version compatibility rather than runtime failures
recommendations.fix: Add to troubleshooting or best practices: how to handle corrupt slides, extraction errors, and partial batch failures with logging recommendations
